notes: Each prompt is routed by a subagent given the full skill roster. We measure whether the two new orchestrators fire when they should (recall) and are NOT stolen for ordinary single-phase work (precision). gold_with = correct skill when orchestration is installed. acceptable_without = plausible routes when orchestration is absent (baseline / graceful degradation).

evals.name: autoship-explicit-issue
evals.prompt: auto-ship issue #214 — take it all the way to a PR for me

evals.name: autoship-pipeline-phrase
evals.prompt: Run the whole pipeline autonomously on this ticket and get it to a ready-for-review PR without me babysitting it.

evals.name: autoship-end-to-end
evals.prompt: Drive this end to end and open the PR — don't stop to ask me at each step.

evals.name: decoy-plain-feature
evals.prompt: Add a rate limiter to the login endpoint.

evals.name: decoy-open-pr
evals.prompt: Open a PR for this branch.

evals.name: decoy-plan-together
evals.prompt: Let's plan this feature together — I want to review each step before we write anything.

evals.name: audit-explicit-claudemd
evals.prompt: Audit the whole codebase against our CLAUDE.md and lint rules and file issues for everything that's drifted.

evals.name: audit-own-rules
evals.prompt: Where are we breaking our own architecture rules? Open tickets for each violation.

evals.name: decoy-bot-comments
evals.prompt: Handle the copilot comments on the PR.

evals.name: decoy-quick-look-no-file
evals.prompt: Do we follow our own conventions? Just take a quick look, don't file anything.
